info.title: Afribox API
info.description: Afribox backend API (SmartParcel). All endpoints accept JSON over POST (unless noted). Authentication is via an `apikey` in the request body: an Application API key, a Business public key, a Business secret key, or (for `/admin/`) a dedicated admin key. Customer read endpoints also accept a `sessiontoken` returned by `/customer/login/`. The HTTP status is 200 (JSON responses are served as `application/json`); the outcome is reported in the body via `statuscode` (`00` = success) and `statusmessage`. A valid request with no results returns `00` with an empty array. Dates are served as `M/d/yyyy h:mm:ss AM/PM` with no timezone (the server is UTC+1); boolean fields are the strings `"True"`/`"False"`.

post.description: Creates a parcel on behalf of the business and reserves a locker. The request type is always **6** (Ramassage sur place / appless reservation) — it is not a request field. Debits the reservation fee from the wallet (prepaid) and sets the drop-off deadline (`expiresat`, default 72 h). Requires the **Business secret key**. Supports an optional `Idempotency-Key` header: an identical replay returns the first response and does not create a second parcel. For a prepaid business with insufficient balance it returns `statuscode` 99, `errorcode` `INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` and message `"Insufficient balance. Required: <fee>, Available: <balance>"`. If never dropped off, the reservation expires (status 8), the locker is released and the fee is forfeited (no refund). The reservation fee debited here is the **single charge** for a type-6 parcel — collection does not charge again.

post.description: Requests that a **dropped-off (status 2) type-6 parcel be retrieved** from its locker. Requires the **secret key**. It sets the retrieval request and does **not** change the parcel status, **does not release the locker** and **does not refund the fee**; there is **no undo**. The retrieval is completed at the kiosk (`/kiosk/parcel/collect/` with the parcel's **`collectcode`**), which sets the parcel to status 4 (`RetrieveCompleted=1`) and frees the locker — only then does it count in `parcelsretrieved` and appear in `/business/retrievedparcels/`. Refused with `09 PARCEL_NOT_RETRIEVABLE` when the parcel is not in a locker, is not type 6, or was already requested. Returns the parcel (same contract as `/business/parcels/info/`), including the **real `collectcode`** (the code the retrieval agent enters).

post.description: Creates a Paystack transaction. Authentication accepts **either** a Business secret key (B2B) **or** an Application API key plus an optional `customerid` (B2C). `amount` is in major units — XOF francs; the gateway's `×100` is applied internally. Use `metadata.parcelreference` to mark a parcel paid, or `metadata.fulfil="wallet"` to credit a business wallet. The response includes `authorizationurl` (hosted checkout) and `accesscode` (for the Paystack popup). `flowtype` is a **top-level** field (not inside `metadata`); it is mirrored to `metadata.flow` and returned as the transaction's `flowtype`. Server-acted `metadata` keys: `parcelreference` (mark a parcel paid), `fulfil: "wallet"` (credit a business wallet), `holdtoken` (finalize a checkout hold), `returnurl` (redirect from `/pay/return/`) and `narration` (wallet-credit text); the server also fills `applicationid`/`businessid`/`customerid`. With `flowtype: "appless"` and a top-level `phone`, the server SMSes the payment link.
